description: Searches allowed local files by metadata and indexed content.

capabilities.description: Search allowed local files by metadata, indexed content, type or volume.

mode.description: metadata lists by type or name, content searches indexed text, hybrid combines content with metadata filters

text.description: Subject or phrase required inside indexed document content; never silently drop a requested subject

name_terms.description: Terms explicitly required in the file name, never document content

volume_ids.description: Trusted volume identifiers selected by the system

user_intent.description: Search local files on allowed disks. Use metadata for files selected only by type/name; content for indexed text only; hybrid for content plus type/name. A subject such as 'PDF about mathematics' must remain in text and use hybrid with the extension. Contains/mentions means content; name_terms is only for an explicit filename. Never invent unavailable filters.
examples: найди все PDF файлы на компьютере
найди текстовый документ в котором встречается нужная фраза
find a text document containing a phrase
